artworks.title: Man with Big Belly
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with one arm outstretched. The person has a rounded face, small eyes, a broad nose, and thick hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. They are wearing a large doublet with puffed sleeves, fitted pants, shoes, and a belt. A sword handle is visible on the left side. The setting is minimal, with the person standing on the ground, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: The Hunchback with the Feathered Cap
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a short, stout figure seen from behind, with a large body and a slight forward lean. They wear a floppy hat with curls, long curly hair, a billowing shirt with folds and buttons, tight pants, pointy shoes, and a sword at their side. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Potbellied Man with the Tall Hat
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a short-statured figure walking or leaning forward. The figure has a large head with exaggerated facial features, long wavy hair flowing from under a large hat with feathers, a loosely fitting jacket, skirt-like garment, simple shoes, and is holding a cane in the left hand and resting the right hand on the hip. The background is plain with a simple line suggestive of the ground.

artworks.title: The Violin Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a character playing the violin. The character has exaggerated, cartoonish features, such as large eyes and a wrinkled face. The character wears a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, and the brim is swept back as if caught by the wind. The attire includes a tunic, belt, and puffy pants. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of 17th-century caricatures, highlighting the character's playful and humorous design.

artworks.title: Masked Man with Twisted Feet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a character standing confidently with one hand on its hip and the other on its head. The character has exaggerated facial features, including a large nose, wide eyes, and long, flowing hair with two prominent strands. It is wearing a long coat, trousers, and high boots with heels. The character is holding an oval object in its left hand and has a sword hanging from its waist. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Lute Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a musicians' stance. The person has exaggerated features including a long nose and expressive, slightly slanted eyes. They wear a wide-brimmed hat, a loose, long-sleeved garment, layered trousers, and striped tights. They hold a stringed instrument akin to a lute. The background is plain with minimal detail.

artworks.title: The Hurdy-Gurdy Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a hunched position, possibly walking or resting. The facial features include deep-set eyes and a prominent nose. The person is wearing a large hat with long ribbon-like elements, a long coat, and layered clothing with textured pants. They are holding round objects in their left hand. The background is plain with subtle markings.

artworks.title: The Flageolet Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoonish figure walking to the right in a hunched-over position. The figure has exaggerated facial features, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a sprig of leaves, a long robe, pants, shoes, and playing a wind instrument. The background is plain with subtle line work suggesting a ground.

artworks.title: Man Scraping a Grill
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a strange figure playing a musical instrument. The figure has exaggerated features, such as an elongated nose, a hunchback, and irregular limbs. The character is dressed in a simple garment and appears to be energetically playing the instrument. The instrument is fantastical with pendulum-like elements hanging from it. The drawing has bold and well-defined lines, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: The Bagpipe Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person playing bagpipes in a slightly crouched position. They have distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose and high cheekbones, and a focused expression. The person has medium-length hair and is dressed in a tunic-like garment with long sleeves and thigh-length. They are wearing leg coverings, and the background is a plain, blank expanse. The illustration is in a monochrome pen-and-ink style with simple lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Masked Comedian Playing a Guitar
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.3 × 7.5 cm (2 1/2 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a lively pose, playing a stringed musical instrument. The person has exaggerated facial features and is wearing a long coat, trousers, and shoes with heels. They have a large hat with a feather and carry a pack on their back. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Guitar Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person holding a stringed instrument in a dynamic stance. The person has exaggerated facial features, unkempt hair flowing back, and is wearing loose-fitting clothes with a belt. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Capricci"
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative text with mythical creatures. The image features intricate decorative elements surrounding a central text. Two muscular mythical creatures frame the text at the top corners. The lower part of the scroll has eye designs. The text within the scroll is presented in varied typography, suggestive of a classical or baroque style. The composition creates a sense of grandeur and artistic flair.

artworks.title: Dedication to Don Lorenzo de' Medici
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative and formal letter or document. The document has elaborate handwriting filled with flourishes, presenting a formal message or dedication to Don Lorenzo Medici. The text is bordered by a simple rectangular frame. An ornate, oversized letter "L" is highlighted prominently at the beginning of the text. The script includes decorative elements such as swirls and varying thickness in the strokes. The design indicates a sense of nobility and formality, fitting for an important communication or dedication to a person of high status. The work is attributed to Jacopo Callot, as noted in the signature.

artworks.title: Gentleman and His Page
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two figures in full body view drawn in an etching style. The figure on the left is walking in profile towards the left side. This person is older with sparse, slightly disheveled hair, and a prominent nose. They wear a long coat and hold a plumed hat in the left hand with a sword hilt visible near the waist. The figure on the right is younger, with fuller, styled hair, wearing a similar long coat with decorative elements at the waist and a sword. Both figures are set against a flat, unvaried background, highlighting the detailed line work.

artworks.title: Two Seated Figures
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two full-length figures seated. The person on the left is sitting on a chair with their body turned to the side, arms resting on the back of the chair. They have short hair with a small curl sticking out from under a feathered hat, wearing a robe-like garment with a striped texture, high boots, and one leg crossed over the other. They are holding a long, thin object that rests on the ground. The person on the right is seated on a block or ledge, wearing a hat that casts a shadow on their face, a long cape, and one leg crossed over the other. Their hands are resting on their knee. The background is plain and undecorated, focusing on the seated individuals.

artworks.title: Shepherd and Ruins
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch with a strong linear perspective. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing a tall structure in the center and a man in the forefront to the right. The horizon is not visible due to the tight framing and dominant architectural elements. The sketch displays detailed fine line work, with vertical and horizontal lines adding texture and depth. It has a monochromatic color palette, using shading and line thickness for depth and detail. A man with a walking stick is on the right, and in the distance, there is a large, rustic building with an archway, partially obscured by vegetation. Two other figures are seen walking towards or near the structure.

artworks.title: Courtyard of a Farm
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic farmstead scene etched in fine lines depicting detailed textures and forms. The scene includes various structures, trees, figures, a horse-drawn cart, and a small dog. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of ivory and black. Tall trees frame the scene.

artworks.title: Ponte Vecchio, Florence
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching featuring a large arched bridge dominating the composition. The perspective is near the figure reclining on the left, with intricate linear details on the bridge. Another smaller arched bridge is visible under the main bridge, crossing a river with figures engaged in activities. The horizon line is lower, showing buildings on the riverbanks. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on fine line work and shading for depth and contrast, imparting a classic and historic feel.

artworks.title: Soldiers Attacking Robbers
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene taking place inside a cave or archway. The composition features several figures engaged in combat or struggle with swords and dramatic gestures. The backdrop includes a cave opening, trees, and a landscape visible in the background. The lines are finely detailed to depict movement and tension. Shadows and textures are used effectively to create contrast and focus within the frame.

artworks.title: The Promenade
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures walking hand in hand towards an open space. They are a man and a woman. The man is dressed in period attire with a hat and a stick or sword, while the woman wears a long dress and a feathered hat. A large tree with thick branches is on the left, framing the couple. In the distance, there are buildings and possibly a church spire. The image is created using fine lines in a monochromatic palette of black ink on a light background.

artworks.title: The Dance
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a circular dance holding hands. The image depicts multiple characters in dynamic poses. The characters are variously attired, with some in flowing robes and others in stylized costumes. Some characters have exaggerated features such as horns. The figures are arranged in a circle with careful attention to detail and movement. The drawing is illustrative in style and may have historical or narrative significance.

artworks.title: Horses Running
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses in various dynamic poses. The horses are depicted with flowing manes and tails, suggesting motion and energy. They are arranged in a scattered yet harmonious composition, with some shown prancing, rearing, or galloping, while others appear in more relaxed positions. The line work gives a classic and timeless quality to the artwork, and adds depth and texture to the figures, making each horse distinct and lively.

artworks.title: Man Moving Abruptly
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 5.6 × 8.6 cm (2 3/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in full-length, drawn in profile facing to the right. They wear wide-brimmed hats, long coats, knee-length pants, and simple shoes. Facial features are outlined, with details around the noses and mouths, and lines suggesting expressions and aging. Both have short facial hair. The artwork is in a line drawing style with a plain background and no other objects present.
